fullSource:
use Ghul
use IO.Std.write_line

let double = (n: int) => n * 2
let increment = (n: int) => n + 1

let double_then_increment = double >> increment
let increment_then_double = increment >> double

write_line("{double_then_increment(5)}")
write_line("{increment_then_double(5)}")
